# pykeleusma

> pykeleusma is the Python binding for Keleusma, a total functional stream processor
> whose scripts have statically bounded worst-case execution time and memory use. The
> distribution is `pykeleusma` and the import package is `keleusma`. The bounds cover
> the script and the bounds declared for each native, and never Python code registered
> as a native.

This file follows the llms.txt convention. It is an index for language models and agents
that read the repository from outside, such as a model asked to write code against it.
Links are absolute, so the file works when fetched on its own.

## Start Here

- [README](https://github.com/sgeos/pykeleusma/blob/main/README.md): overview, installation, examples, limitations and the guarantee boundary.
- [Type stub](https://github.com/sgeos/pykeleusma/blob/main/python/keleusma/_keleusma.pyi): the complete public interface with types.
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/sgeos/pykeleusma/blob/main/AGENTS.md): onboarding for any AI assistant working in the repository.
- [CLAUDE.md](https://github.com/sgeos/pykeleusma/blob/main/CLAUDE.md): authoritative project context, conventions and per-session protocol.

## Documentation

- [Documentation index](https://github.com/sgeos/pykeleusma/blob/main/docs/README.md): architecture, decisions, roadmap and process.
- [Binding design](https://github.com/sgeos/pykeleusma/blob/main/docs/architecture/BINDING_DESIGN.md): how the binding maps Keleusma onto Python, and the known issues in dependencies.
